title: rddmwmddr/android-ad-cleaner
why_read: A practical utility for removing bloatware and ad injections from Chinese Android phones without rooting, useful to a specific but sizable user base.
analysis: This tool targets a widespread annoyance on many Chinese-market Android phones, where manufacturers bundle aggressive ad injection, 'hot search' content, and marketing push notifications into the stock OS. Being root-free and reversible lowers the risk compared to typical debloating tools that require deeper system access. It's a narrow-audience but genuinely useful piece of software for people stuck with these devices, and the AI-agent execution feature is a modest convenience addition rather than a technical innovation.
